Method of Attack: Deploying ransomware payloads across Windows domains compromised using Windows PetitPotam exploits
Dropping web shells on breached Microsoft Exchange servers to upload and execute malicious tools
Attack Vector: Exploitation of ProxyShell vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-34473, CVE-2021-34523, CVE-2021-31207) on on-premises Microsoft Exchange servers
Indicators of Compromise: Over 140 web shells deployed on more than 1,900 compromised Microsoft Exchange servers
Thousands of vulnerable Exchange servers tracked by Shodan, mostly in the US and Germany
